L1.statement: the fixed_child q=11 22-parent fixed_child has a two-element quotient (its two sheets of 11); it is torsor-isomorphic to T_11 (two PSL_2(11) orbits of one 22-element PGL_2(11) orbit) and the reduction of Rz (outer coset, det 2 nonsquare mod 11) exchanges its two points, compatibly with the arithmetic_orientation dictionary.

L2.conclusion: affine_cocycle (Cech cocycle), orbit_selector (one-bit selector), and arithmetic_orientation (free C2 torsor) are three functors of the single class [T_q] = sgn: PGL_2(q) -> PGL_2(q)/PSL_2(q).

square_a_affine_cocycle.claim: affine_cocycle cocycle class = image of [T_q] under the sheet dictionary

square_b_orbit_selector.claim: orbit_selector one-bit selector cost attained exactly by [T_q] nontriviality

A3_q5.marker_fibre: one projective F_5 point (Frobenius orbit of the two spin lifts)

L3.M12_clause: At the extended Hadamard / M12 layer the orientation bit is invisible to every inner symmetry: N_{M12}(PSL_2(11)) = PSL_2(11) is self-normalising (design_fourier_hinge-F), PGL_2(11) is not a subgroup of M12, and the two M11 parents are non-conjugate in M12, so the sheet swap is realised only by the outer, row/column-exchanging class of M12 - the same free C2 torsor forced outer one layer up.

verdict: L1 TORSOR-ISOMORPHIC | L2 ONE TORSOR CLASS (THREE CERTIFICATES) | L3 RANK-THREE COMPLETION HOLDS (+ forced-outer M12 clause)
